threat_event: Attacker uses a stolen or shared integrator credential on the group OT remote access gateway to reach control systems at several plants and Terminal T1
threat_source: Criminal or state-sponsored group targeting chemical OT; malicious insider at an integrator
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 integrators and OEMs and the engineering hub reach every site through one gateway; shared team accounts; no per-session site approval; recording at 9 of 17 sites; standing hub connections
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G1 OT remote access gateway; SYS-C1 to SYS-C6; SYS-C8; SYS-D1
existing_controls: MFA on the gateway; OT desk monitoring; SIS at RMP-covered plants
treatment_plan: Named integrator accounts; per-session approval by the site; recording at all sites; remove standing hub connections; phishing-resistant MFA for engineering sessions

threat_event: Cyber-initiated loss of control causes a toxic release or fire at an RMP-covered plant
threat_source: Adversary manipulating control systems; malware in OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PHAs at Plant C1 and the Program 2 plants do not treat control system compromise as a cause, so safeguards that share a failure mode with the DCS are credited; MOC gaps for logic and recipes
affected_asset_or_process: Plant C1 chlorine process (Program 3); 4 Program 2 ammonia plants
existing_controls: Independent SIS on every RMP-covered process; emergency response program and 2025 field exercise
treatment_plan: Add cyber causes to PHA revalidations; route DCS, SIS, and recipe changes through plant MOC everywhere; OT security reviewer on MOC

threat_event: Ransomware on ERP-connected servers stops order release and hazmat shipping papers in all three divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: All divisions print shipping papers from ERP product data; integration servers reachable from the corporate network; pre-printed fallback covers 500 of 11,000 products
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G4; SYS-T1; SYS-D2; Plant loading racks
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR; immutable backups; ERP recovery runbook
treatment_plan: Segment ERP integration servers; extend the shipping paper fallback to all bulk products; cross-division tabletop (P08)

threat_event: AI or analytics change physical process setpoints without MOC, safety review, or governance
threat_source: Process failure; well-meaning engineering change; attacker abusing the AI path
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI-001 was switched to automatic setpoint writes in 2026-06 without MOC or AI council approval; Group AI Standard adopted 2026-07-01, after the change
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-C9 AI-001; Plant C1 hypochlorite reactors; driver camera AI (SYS-T2)
existing_controls: Bounded write ranges; SIS trips; AI-001 returned to advisory on 2026-09-03
treatment_plan: Group AI Standard change gate; AI-001 conditions (P10); MOC for any AI that touches setpoints

threat_event: Ransomware or intrusion spreads through flat networks at legacy plants and stops production for weeks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 7 legacy plants: flat networks, dual-homed historians, unsupported HMIs, always-on integrator tools at 2, no OT monitoring, untested backups at 5
existing_controls: Plant SIS where RMP applies; EDR on plant IT
treatment_plan: Migrate legacy plants to the OT standard by 2027-12-31; remove always-on tools now; offline backups first
owner: Specialty Chemicals Vice President of Manufacturing Technology

threat_event: Terminal T1 misses USCG cyber rule duties and its OT is exposed from the office network
threat_source: Process failure; attacker on the terminal office network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cybersecurity Plan not drafted (due 2027-07-16); 23 contractors untrained and not monitored; no approved hardware and software list; 2022 network map; rack and gauging PLCs share the office segment
existing_controls: Facility Security Plan; CySO designated 2025; OT sensors at Terminal T1
treatment_plan: Training catch-up; segmentation; approved list and inventory; Assessment and Plan submitted before 2027-07-16
owner: Distribution Cybersecurity Officer (CySO) for Terminal T1

threat_event: One incident triggers release, Coast Guard, DOT, SEC, state breach, and customer notices and some are missed or late
threat_source: Process failure during a cross-division incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The single notification matrix has not been exercised; release notices, Coast Guard reports, and SEC materiality are owned by different teams
existing_controls: Release notices practiced annually; disclosure committee charter
treatment_plan: Cross-division tabletop on 2026-12-08 combined with the Plant C1 RMP tabletop; matrix owners named

threat_event: Compromise of the managed inventory telemetry vendor portal disrupts deliveries to water utilities
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The vendor portal that configures about 2,600 gateways has no MFA; about 640 sites are utilities that rely on automatic replenishment
existing_controls: Telemetry anomaly alerts; customer service call lists
treatment_plan: MFA on the vendor portal; vendor security addendum; daily reconciliation of utility tank levels

threat_event: Hazmat Transport cannot show which controls it inherits, so gaps in its own controls go unseen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Common control inheritance not documented for Hazmat Transport
existing_controls: Group common controls operate for all divisions
treatment_plan: Inheritance matrix for Hazmat Transport; confirm annually
owner: Hazmat Transport security and compliance lead

threat_event: Division staff follow an outdated supplement that conflicts with group policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hazmat Transport supplement last aligned in 2023
existing_controls: Group policy governs where documents conflict
treatment_plan: Re-issue the supplement; annual alignment attestation
owner: Hazmat Transport security and compliance lead

threat_event: A hazmat load is stolen or diverted after dispatch or telematics systems are compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Carrier and offeror security plans do not assess cyber threats to dispatch, electronic shipping papers, telematics, and ELDs
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-T1; SYS-T2; loads of hydrogen peroxide and Class 3 solvents
existing_controls: Geofence and stop-time alerts; driver check calls
treatment_plan: Add cyber threats to all three security plans; alert on dispatch changes for security plan loads
owner: Hazmat Transport Vice President of Safety and Compliance

threat_event: Formulations and recipes are stolen and used by competitors or foreign actors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recipes on the engineering hub, plant batch systems, and the data platform; generative formulation assistant pilot
existing_controls: Role-based access; data loss prevention on email
treatment_plan: Recipe library access review; query logging; formulation assistant terms
owner: Specialty Chemicals Director of Process Control Engineering

threat_event: A compromised integrator or OEM delivers malware or unsafe changes to plants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 of 14 integrator contracts lack security clauses and incident notice terms; 8 not assessed
existing_controls: Hash checks on vendor media; on-site escort
treatment_plan: Security addendum for all integrators; assessments; OT training for gateway users

threat_event: A cyber incident is disclosed late or inaccurately to the SEC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Materiality decisions depend on facts from OT, release, and breach teams
treatment_plan: Materiality criteria for OT and safety events in the P08 runbook

threat_event: A privileged insider sabotages control systems or diverts a hazmat load
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Engineers and dispatchers hold broad rights; shared accounts limit attribution
treatment_plan: Named accounts everywhere; DCS change review; dispatch change alerts

threat_event: The Group ERC number goes unanswered during a hazmat emergency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One number on every group shipping paper
existing_controls: Backup ERC site with automatic routing, tested twice a year

threat_event: Employee and driver personal information is stolen in a ransomware event
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HR exports and driver qualification files hold PII for about 45,000 employees and about 4,600 current and former drivers
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171; state breach laws; FMCSA 382.405
treatment_plan: Remove bulk HR exports from file shares; vendor access review

threat_event: A hurricane hits Florida sites (Plant C1, Terminal T1, headquarters) while a cyber recovery is under way
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Florida concentration of the flagship plant, the MTSA terminal, and headquarters
affected_asset_or_process: Plant C1; Terminal T1; Group ERC primary site
existing_controls: Hurricane plans; ERC backup site outside Florida; cloud recovery in provider B
treatment_plan: Combine hurricane and cyber recovery in the 2027 exercise
